definitions.text: The sterile hybrid offspring of a male horse and a female donkey.
A hybrid between a stallion and an ass; -- correlative of the mule.
A term of endearment; darling; -- corrupted from honey.
The hybrid offspring of a stallion (male horse) and a she-ass (female donkey).

examples.title: Blue Adept
examples.text: I knew nothing about that horse except that a hinny was the sterile issue of stallion and jenny, most like a mule but prettier, yet already I was eager to ride her.

examples.title: Chapter 5
examples.text: A hinny is the offspring of a stallion and a she - donkey.

examples.title: The Physical Life of Woman: Advice to the Maiden, Wife and Mother
examples.text: On the other hand, the hinny, which is the offspring of the stallion and the she-ass, is essentially a modified horse, having the general configuration of the horse, but being a much smaller animal than its sire, and therefore approaching the dam in size as well as in the comparative narrowness of its trunk.

examples.title: Eventide A Series of Tales and Poems
examples.text: Aunt Patty said she should be lost without her hinny, and George Wild remonstrated half angrily with her, for going off to leave him alone; but all to no effect -- Annie must go.

examples.title: Don`t Get Me Started
examples.text: Newcastle City Coucil banned staff from saying pet and hinny, Blackpool taxi drivers were prevented from flaunting the cross of St. George.

examples.title: The Heart of Mid-Lothian
examples.text: Mony a warsle he has had for that puir lassie — I am thinking he petitions mair for her than for yoursell, hinny; for what can he plead for you but just to wish you the blessing ye deserve?

examples.title: Cold Mountain
examples.text: He rode off one morning on their old hinny to do battle, and Ruby had heard nothing from him since.
